record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK (second review, after fix-area-levels-review)
findings:
  - task: fix-area-levels-review (R18 close fallback) / missing-test / minor: two changed call sites have no test that asserts the hash: the overlay Back button (`close-detail`) in Overlay.svelte and the close after a successful write in overlay.svelte.ts. Reverting either to `closeDetail()` keeps the suite green.
  - task: phase / spec-gap / judgment: `leaveHref()` reads `polling.selectedEffort`. On a fresh load of `#/phase/...`, `#/requirement/...`, `#/needs/...`, `#/backlog/...` or `#/task/<id>`, the selection defaults to the first visible effort, while the breadcrumb and rail resolve the effort from the route. Back can go to a different effort than the breadcrumb shows. Main behaved the same way; it is a mismatch, not a regression.
  - task: phase / spec-gap / judgment: App.svelte always renders SideRail. On `#/` and `#/area/<s>` the side rail shows the Backlog panel, a Needs-you panel and the journal teaser of an arbitrary first effort next to the product index and the area page. The area page already lists its own Needs-you rows. The R17 test scans only `main`, so it misses this.
integration: all four review fixes confirmed correct; R1 to R26 and R28 to R31 have named tests; R27 holds; design invariants hold, with the exception noted for the URL-as-source-of-truth item. No conflicts between work items.
(Condensed by the parent for storage.)
record.subject: area-levels-review
